description: État par immeuble des déploiements sur le marché du haut et très haut débit en Loire-Atlantique is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. État par immeuble sur l'ensemble du territoire de la Loire-Atlantique des déploiements sur le marché du haut et très haut débit fixes issu de la collecte trimestrielle "Observatoire de gros HD/THD" au titre de la décision n°2012-1503. Le champ imbetat (Etat du déploiement de l'immeuble) permet à l'opérateur d'immeuble de communiquer le statut de l'adresse. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Territoires. Its keywords are ftth, haut-débit, très-haut-débit, éligibilité, internet, fibre. The portal shows 578,670 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-12-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
